ROOT.triggerdef: CREATE TRIGGER CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci_UsunPotomne ON CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci FOR DELETE AS begin if @@NESTLEVEL>4 return SET NOCOUNT ON declare @lista table (PTC_Id int) insert into @lista select PTC_Id from deleted while 1=1 begin insert into @lista select CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci.PTC_Id from @lista Lista inner join CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci on CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci.PTC_Ojciec=Lista.PTC_Id left outer join @Lista Sa on Sa.PTC_Id=CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci.PTC_Id where Sa.PTC_Id is null if @@RowCount=0 break end delete CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci from CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci inner join @lista Lista on Lista.PTC_Id=CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci.PTC_Id left outer join deleted on deleted.PTC_Id=CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci.PTC_Id where deleted.PTC_Id is null SET NOCOUNT OFF end
